scientific_integrity: Classical derangement counts, the signed derangement identity, and previously published connectivity of nonmaximum independent sets in connected claw-free line graphs are credited. No independent audit or publication priority certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact shortest-path, radius and diameter census is established only for \(3\le n\le8\) by two reproducible finite exhaustive checkers, with the marked-cycle orbit-reduction proof. No diameter formula is proved for \(n\ge9\). All-order enumerative/parity facts have separate combinatorial proofs. Earlier unindexed crown-specific distances might overlap.
title: Two-hole crown matching slides: exact eccentricity geometry through eight columns
